measured.concurrency_notes: single-seq deep-context config (MAX_NUM_SEQS=1); 439,622-token nvfp4 KV pool; prefill ~1,024 tok/s at start decaying to ~350-614 past 300k

extra_setup: start.sh generates compose.yml (not shipped). First boot downloads ~107 GB into ./hf-hub (bound at /hf-cache), coalesces rank-sliced TP4 EXL3 -> TP1 into ./data/tp1 (/models), builds K64 DSpark draft, runs selftest. Optional ./download.sh does download+coalesce offline. Bind-mounts from image-patch/: entrypoint-256k.sh -> /opt/recipe/scripts/entrypoint.sh, entrypoint-toolfix.sh -> /patch-run-entrypoint.sh (pip upgrades xgrammar>=0.2.4, pins transformers==5.13.1 at boot), serve-ds4-flash.sh -> /opt/vllm/serve-ds4-flash.sh, coalesce_rank_sliced_exl3.py, dspark.py, and sparkinfer kernel backports (_impl.py, tiny_decode.py, prefill.py, prefill_mg.py). ./cache -> /cache. Disable earlyoom; needs >=114.3 GiB free host RAM at launch; aarch64 only.
notes: args are the resolved `vllm serve` command produced by serve-ds4-flash.sh (run as /opt/runtime-venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main) under start.sh defaults; the entrypoint-256k.sh additionally exports BACKEND=b12x-a8 INDEXER_BACKEND=b12x ALLREDUCE_MODE=nccl TP_SIZE=1 DCP_SIZE=1 KV_CACHE_DTYPE=nvfp4_ds_mla LOAD_FORMAT=instanttensor PREFIX_CACHE=1 ENABLE_FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE=1 VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=0 XDG_CACHE_HOME=/cache DSPARK_DRAFT_ATTENTION_BACKEND=B12X_MLA_SPARSE DRAFT_SAMPLE_METHOD=probabilistic, and serve-ds4-flash.sh exports many more (VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1, VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE=1, CUTE_DSL_ARCH=sm_120a, NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1, B12X_MOE_FORCE_A8=1, VLLM_USE_B12X_FP8_GEMM=1 ...). KV_RECORD=stock432 (432-byte native NVFP4 KV records); KV_RECORD=padded fallback gives ~270k pool. MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS 8224 also locks the b12x MLA workspace - do not lower. Optional ABLATE=1 runtime refusal-direction ablation overlay (off by default). No auth on port.
